cases.name: Alyssa Nicole Pinardo
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Alyssa was a student at Brunswick High School. She was set to graduate this spring.

In addition to being a student, in her free time she embraced her passions for photography, music and nature, while also staying busy working two jobs at Taco Bell and Pizza Hut. If you knew Alyssa, you were sure to smile from her laughter, and caring spirit. Her friends and family knew that if they ever needed her, she would be there for you in any way that she could. She was very connected with her friends. They will miss her dearly. Alyssa had dreams and aspirations after graduation to become a business woman."
